entries.zh: 对头；敌手；正面对立的一方
entries.en: Opponents; adversaries; those who face each other
entries.notes: M 栏并列 tui chiû 与 tong tōui 两组读法、R 栏对音可疑，义按“對頭/當頭”的对立义处理。

entries.zh: 轻触；轻微冒犯；对人略示相左
entries.en: To touch lightly; to give slight offence; to be mildly contrary to someone
entries.notes: L 栏文字舛误（resqitar 疑为 respetar），H 栏“輕觸”义取轻碰、轻犯。

entries.en: Opponent; adversary; enemy

entries.zh: 对手；竞争或争执中的对方
entries.en: Opponent; rival; the other party in a contest
To violate a taboo; to offend against a name taboo

entries.zh: 交易；议价成交；订约雇请
entries.en: To trade; to strike a bargain; to contract or hire
entries.notes: H 栏作“駁”而 M/R 均读 huàn/huān（音近“換”），字形与对音不合，义从 L 栏 contratar。

entries.en: 〔Original defective; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆空，仅存残损西语，无法定夺。

entries.en: To trade; to do business; to carry on commerce
Livelihood; means of living; trade or occupation
To exchange; to deal with one another; to trade
entries.notes: R 栏 giāu/giān 有疑，H 栏“交加”义取交接互换。

entries.en: To have dealings with; to communicate; to consort
entries.notes: R 栏 giān/giāu 有疑，义按“交通”的往来、勾通义。

entries.zh: 以货易货；兑货；货物交易
entries.en: To barter; to exchange goods; to contract in goods
entries.notes: R 栏 hō/hò 有疑，L 栏 en hacienda 义取货物、产业上的交易。

entries.zh: 店铺兑货；向店铺换货、订货
entries.en: To exchange goods at a shop; to deal for goods at a shop
entries.notes: H 栏“對店貨”字面为对店中之货，义取店铺交易。

entries.en: To buy and sell; to trade
To decide; to determine; to settle by judgment
To recover from illness; to convalesce; to get well
entries.notes: H 栏“瘥/産”存疑，“瘥”与 L 栏 convalecer 相合。

entries.en: To recover (from illness); to be cured
entries.notes: H 栏“痊/瘥”存疑，二字均指病愈。

entries.zh: 止口；封住嘴巴；使人无言以对
entries.en: To stop someone's mouth; to silence; to talk someone down
entries.notes: M/R 两栏皆有疑，H 栏“止口”义取止住口舌。

entries.zh: 神速（字面义“极快”，与西语“以理说服”不合，疑残讹）
entries.en: Marvellously fast (as written; at odds with 'to convince by reason'; probably corrupt)
entries.notes: M 栏标[残]、R 栏带 T99 污损，四栏语义不能互证。

entries.zh: 考倒人；出题难倒人；考试使人落第
entries.en: To stump someone with questions; to fail a candidate in an examination
entries.notes: R 栏 kōu/kūu 有疑，H 栏“考倒人”与 L 栏 examen 相合。

entries.en: To be in harmony; to agree; to conform
entries.notes: H 栏“雍/庸”存疑、R 栏 òng/ōng 有疑，L 栏 conformar 与“雍”（和）相合。
